The next course introduces supervised and unsupervised learning, and feature engineering (COU3570). The path then builds on this knowledge with a course on deep learning and neural networks (COU1633), followed by a course on practical skills in deep learning with TensorFlow 2 (COU4094). The next course introduces PyTorch for deep learning (COU4929), and the following course provides practical skills in computer vision with PyTorch (COU3002). The final course is an advanced course on MLOps, integrating the previous courses (COU4852). The path concludes with an advanced course on AI enterprise workflow (COU2377), building on the previous courses.

learning_path:
**Learning Path Table**
| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COU4099 | Calculus through Data & Modeling: Limits & Derivatives | Coursera | Reviewing limits and derivatives is essential for a strong foundation in calculus. |
| 2 | COU288 | Calculus through Data & Modeling: Differentiation Rules | Coursera | Building on the previous course, this one covers differentiation rules, a crucial concept in calculus. |
| 3 | COU4437 | Calculus: Single Variable Part 1 - Functions | Coursera | This course introduces functions, a fundamental concept in calculus, and provides a solid understanding of series expansions. |
| 4 | COU4065 | Introduction to Advanced Calculus | Coursera | With a solid grasp of functions and differentiation, this course covers advanced calculus topics, including differential equations and series representations. |
| 5 | COU75 | Calculus for Machine Learning and Data Science | Coursera | This course applies advanced calculus concepts to machine learning and data science, making it relevant to the learner's future engineering degree. |

**Learning Path Explanation**

This learning path starts with a review of limits and derivatives (COU4099) to ensure a strong foundation in calculus. The next course (COU288) builds on this foundation by covering differentiation rules, a crucial concept in calculus. The third course (COU4437) introduces functions, a fundamental concept in calculus, and provides a solid understanding of series expansions. With a solid grasp of functions and differentiation, the learner is ready to tackle advanced calculus topics, including differential equations and series representations (COU4065). Finally, this course applies advanced calculus concepts to machine learning and data science (COU75), making it relevant to the learner's future engineering degree. This path follows the educational principles of building on prior knowledge, gradual increase in cognitive load, emphasizing conceptual understanding, pacing and practice, motivation through relevance, and sequencing learning to build on skills.

learning_path:
**Course Path**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | EDX1522 | Computational Probability and Inference | edx | Foundational understanding of probability and inference |
| 2 | EDX2908 | Math for Machine Learning with Python | edx | Building on probability and inference, introducing linear algebra and optimization |
| 3 | EDX2454 | Math for Machine Learning with R | edx | Introducing R programming and machine learning concepts |
| 4 | EDX2053 | Computing for Data Analysis | edx | Building on R programming, introducing data analysis and visualization |
| 5 | EDX873 | Analyzing Data with Python | edx | Introducing Python programming and data analysis |
| 6 | EDX2054 | Machine Learning Fundamentals | edx | Building on data analysis, introducing machine learning fundamentals |
| 7 | EDX3095 | Predictive Analytics: Basic Modeling Techniques | edx | Introducing predictive analytics and machine learning modeling techniques |
| 8 | EDX207 | Machine Learning with Python: from Linear Models to Deep Learning | edx | Building on machine learning fundamentals, introducing deep learning concepts |

## How the path fits together

This course path starts with a foundational understanding of probability and inference, introducing the learner to the mathematical concepts necessary for machine learning. The next course builds on this foundation, introducing linear algebra and optimization. The learner then delves into R programming and machine learning concepts, followed by building on R programming to introduce data analysis and visualization. The path continues with introducing Python programming and data analysis, and then building on data analysis to introduce machine learning fundamentals. Finally, the learner is introduced to predictive analytics and machine learning modeling techniques, and concludes with a course on machine learning with Python, from linear models to deep learning. This path provides a comprehensive understanding of linear algebra, probability, and machine learning, allowing the learner to follow machine learning papers with confidence.

| 1 | EDX2521 | Introduction to Biology - The Secret of Life | edx | Foundational knowledge in biology, covering the building blocks of life, genetics, and molecular biology. |
| 2 | EDX3139 | Genomic Medicine Gets Personal | edx | Building on the foundational knowledge, this course explores the basics of genetic abnormalities, disease, and genetic testing. |
| 3 | EDX424 | Molecular Foundations of Medicine | edx | This course delves deeper into molecular biology, covering topics such as the central dogma, genomics, and genomics data science. |
| 4 | EDX1589 | Algorithms and Data Structures Capstone | edx | Advanced course in data analysis and algorithms, applying computational methods to biological problems. |
| 5 | EDX1983 | Nature, in Code: Biology in JavaScript | edx | Introduces programming skills in JavaScript, applying computational thinking to biological concepts. |
| 6 | EDX340 | Biotech — From Science to Business | edx | Covers the business aspects of biotechnology, including entrepreneurship, innovation, and market analysis. |
| 7 | EDX2082 | Principles of Synthetic Biology | edx | Advanced course in synthetic biology, covering modern techniques in DNA assembly, gene expression, and protein activity. |
| 8 | EDX3273 | CRISPR: Gene-editing Applications | edx | Focuses on the applications of CRISPR technology in various industries, including biotech, agriculture, and healthcare. |
| 9 | EDX1248 | Advanced Knowledge and Skills of Originator and Biosimilar Biologics: For Health Care Providers | edx | Advanced course in biologics, covering the scientific and clinical evidence for biosimilar applications. |
| 10 | EDX2768 | Introduction to Applied Biostatistics: Statistics for Medical Research | edx | Introduces statistical methods for medical research, including data analysis and interpretation. |
| 11 | EDX1084 | Biostatistics for Big Data Applications | edx | Covers the basics of biostatistics, including R programming, data visualization, and statistical inference. |
| 12 | EDX893 | Excel for Beginners | edx | Essential course in spreadsheet skills, including data entry, manipulation, and visualization. |
| 13 | EDX2198 | Human Anatomy and Physiology I | edx | Foundational knowledge in human anatomy and physiology, covering the integumentary, skeletal, muscular, and nervous systems. |
| 14 | EDX2844 | Human Anatomy and Physiology II | edx | Continues the study of human anatomy and physiology, covering the endocrine, circulatory, immune, respiratory, digestive, excretory, and reproductive systems. |
| 15 | EDX3345 | Exercise Physiology | edx | Advanced course in exercise physiology, covering the effects of exercise on health and the body's reaction to physical activity. |

**How the path fits together**

This learning path starts with foundational knowledge in biology and genetics, gradually building on that knowledge to cover advanced topics in molecular biology, synthetic biology, and biotechnology. The path includes a mix of courses on data analysis, algorithms, and statistical methods, as well as courses on business and entrepreneurship. The final courses focus on advanced topics in exercise physiology, human anatomy and physiology, and biostatistics. The path is designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of molecular biology and genetics, as well as the skills and knowledge needed to apply that understanding in various fields.

learning_path:
**Learning Path for a Complete Beginner in Photography and Visual Design**
====================================================================

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COU5230 | Photography Basics and Beyond: From Smartphone to DSLR Specialization | Coursera | Introduces the basics of photography, including light, composition, and visual elements. |
| 2 | COU4519 | Photography Capstone Project | Coursera | Allows the learner to apply their new skills through a practical project, receiving feedback and developing a sense of accomplishment. |
| 3 | COU5235 | Graphic Design Elements for Non-Designers Specialization | Coursera | Introduces the fundamentals of graphic design, including color theory, typography, and visual elements. |
| 4 | COU4668 | Graphic Design Fundamentals | Coursera | Develops the learner's understanding of visual principles, creative problem-solving, and critical thinking. |
| 5 | COU1471 | Graphic Design | Coursera | Focuses on developing transferable skills, such as understanding of visual principles, creative problem-solving, and critical thinking. |
| 6 | COU3986 | Agile Development Specialization | Coursera | Introduces the learner to design thinking and how it is used in UX/UI design, allowing them to develop a portfolio of their designs. |
| 7 | COU3968 | Fundamentals of UI/UX Design | Coursera | Develops the learner's understanding of user experience design (UXD) and human-centered design (HCD), allowing them to create a portfolio of their designs. |
| 8 | COU1298 | Design Thinking Specialization | Coursera | Focuses on developing the learner's strategic thinking, creativity, and innovation skills, allowing them to create a unique visual voice. |

**How the path fits together**

This learning path is designed to take a complete beginner in photography and visual design from the basics of photography to advanced design thinking and UX/UI design. The path starts with the basics of photography, including light, composition, and visual elements (COU5230). The learner then applies their new skills through a practical project, receiving feedback and developing a sense of accomplishment (COU4519). Next, the learner is introduced to the fundamentals of graphic design, including color theory, typography, and visual elements (COU5235). The learner then develops their understanding of visual principles, creative problem-solving, and critical thinking (COU4668). The path continues with a focus on developing transferable skills, such as understanding of visual principles, creative problem-solving, and critical thinking (COU1471). The learner is then introduced to design thinking and how it is used in UX/UI design, allowing them to develop a portfolio of their designs (COU3986). Finally, the learner develops their understanding of user experience design (UXD) and human-centered design (HCD), allowing them to create a unique visual voice (COU3968).

**Learning Path**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | COU1458 | English Language Skills A2-B1 CEFR: Low-Intermediate Specialization | Coursera | Foundational course to establish a solid base in English language skills, including grammar, vocabulary, and reading comprehension. |
| 2 | COU4837 | Low Intermediate English: Help & Information | Coursera | Builds on the foundational course, focusing on important language for asking for help, giving and understanding directions, and sharing opinions. |
| 3 | COU6106 | Business English Communication Skills Specialization | Coursera | Introduces business English communication skills, including vocabulary, grammar, and listening comprehension, to prepare the learner for more advanced technical communication skills. |
| 4 | COU1609 | Business English: Networking | Coursera | Develops the learner's ability to communicate effectively in a business setting, including email writing, business communication, and networking. |
| 5 | COU2362 | English for Effective Business Speaking | Coursera | Focuses on improving the learner's business English speaking skills, including vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, and spoken communication skills. |
| 6 | COU4648 | Low Intermediate English: Calls & Messaging | Coursera | Enhances the learner's ability to communicate effectively in a business setting, including phone, email, text, and social media communication. |
| 7 | COU2201 | Low Intermediate English: Shopping & Customer Service | Coursera | Develops the learner's language skills for describing how to shop, review what's been bought, and assist customers, preparing them for more advanced customer service skills. |
| 8 | COU4252 | Low Intermediate English: Planning & Organization | Coursera | Focuses on the learner's ability to plan their life, including social life, travels, and work, using important language for planning and organization. |
| 9 | COU5945 | English for Effective Business Writing | Coursera | Improves the learner's business English writing skills, including vocabulary, grammar, and understanding of different business writing genres. |
| 10 | COU2975 | Arizona State University TESOL Professional Certificate | Coursera | Provides a beginner-level course in English language teaching, preparing the learner for more advanced teaching and communication skills. |

The learning path progresses from foundational to advanced, covering the full duration of the learner's request. Each course builds on the previous one, introducing new skills and concepts in a gradual and manageable way. The path emphasizes practical application, motivation through relevance and feedback, and flexibility and adaptability to accommodate the learner's individual needs.
